It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Ōtsuki → Photo stop near Yoshii is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

This Photo stop near Yoshii → Kashima-shi stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Food stop near Kashima-shi → Near Chōfu is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.title: Storm King Highway → Seven Lakes Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 33 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

bear-mountain-and-hudson-highlands-and-n.story: From Riverdale it runs 614 km to Albertson; allow about 11 h 10 of riding. The stops in between: Bear Mountain Bridge, Cold Spring, Storm King Highway and Seven Lakes Drive. Sea Bright is the high point. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
